judgments.reason: Both are coherent; B reaches the fictional inspection immediately and explains the connector and inspection techniques clearly, with less introductory framing.

Both coherently relate household routines to light and shared space. A reaches a named household earlier; B explains the relation between room use and lighting more directly. Neither opening has an evident instruction violation.
Both give an accessible, coherent introduction to map selection and scale with a concrete hiking-map ratio; differences are mainly phrasing.
Both follow a washing machine that drains but will not spin, clearly motivating diagnosis as a hidden repair cost. B is more specific about machine type, without a decisive quality difference.

Both begin with realistic site suitability and soil questions. B adds land tenure and delayed harvest; A reaches sunlight and water sooner. These are reasonable differences in ordering within truncated openings.

Both establish believable neighbors, the shared radio program, and concrete domestic details. B reaches discovery sooner; the required failed conversation lies beyond both excerpts, so it cannot be assessed.
Both establish a nearly empty evening ferry, an object attracting notice, and personal bereavement stakes. Neither opening introduces crime or a supernatural explanation.

B uses restrained exchanges and visible mending to reveal the coat history during the tailor’s work. A is coherent but adds a speculative blood stain that distracts from the requested restrained fitting scene.

A gives practical grounds-maintenance context and shows the caretaker preserving the uprooted seedling in a pot. This better establishes understandable competing concerns than B’s emphasis on obeying the schedule.

Both establish a specific borrowed film camera and a plausible reluctant narrator. A gives vivid fair details; B develops the borrowing relationship through effective dialogue. The later collaboration is outside both openings.

Both retain the distinction between activity and progress and use a clearly hypothetical software-team example. Neither opening reaches the interruption tradeoff yet; the shared truncation prevents assessing that part.

Both turn the notes into a coherent proposal with budget, volunteer, interpretation, and access concerns. A spends longer on the problem; B gets to a concrete reduction proposal sooner. Neither has an evident instruction failure in the opening.

A preserves the draft’s balance by naming stallholder and bus-passenger concerns and a broader trial within the introduction. B gives more space to congestion and adds a specific road layout not present in the draft.
A states the practical teaching sequence clearly and reaches concrete workshop tasks without B’s unsupported first-person claim of years of teaching experience.

Both coherently explain why objects need context. A supplies a specific photograph anecdote while B explains missing context more generally. Neither ending or later disagreement discussion is available, so those requirements cannot be judged.

reviewer: Primary coding agent; policy labels masked during review
limitations: One reviewer and first-repeat 256-token openings only. Subjective preference, not a quality noninferiority test, expert factual audit, or full-answer evaluation.
